name: Velmora Dairy Stabilization Act

source_sentences: Raw milk produced on farms registered in Velmora must be bought at a price of at least $21.00 per cwt by any plant located in Velmora that buys it.
Milk produced outside Velmora, even when processed in Velmora, is exempt.

The Velmora Dairy Board buys any quantity of block cheddar and nonfat dry milk offered by licensed Velmora plants, at $2.05 a pound for cheddar and $1.40 for powder (prices set so that a plant paying $21 for milk breaks even), provided the product is certified as made from Velmora milk paid at least the floor.
The Velmora Dairy Board enforces K1 and K2.
It is funded by an open-ended ("sum sufficient") appropriation from the general fund.
The governor proposed the program in February of Year 0.

context: Raw milk prices in the region have averaged $18 per hundredweight (cwt) over five years, varying between $15 and $22; forward prices for the next three years are $17 to $19.
The neighboring states of Ostrand and Quillon, whose dairy areas lie 30 to 90 miles from Velmora's, have no floor.
